data.why: These are exact copies of the repo's bundled sample traces (data/samples/1/), small CSVs (~472 rows) matching the t/i column format load_signal() auto-detects, given to the browser as upload files for the Load Raw and Load Ambient (optional) file_uploader widgets.

goals: Load a raw calcium-imaging trace and, optionally, an ambient/background trace, and subtract the ambient signal with the right offset and scale
Smooth the trace with an appropriate level to denoise without distorting transient morphology
Detect and curate peaks into discrete periods, removing artifactual or incomplete beats
Review the overlay of normalized periods to check consistency of mean and dispersion
Extract per-period and aggregated metrics (APD20/50/90, rise/decay times, slopes, AUC) for downstream analysis
Export a reproducible bundle (Excel workbook, figures, session JSON) documenting the analysis

review.summary: The tree follows KAI's stated Load → Subtract → Smooth → Detect → Curate → Overlay → Metrics → Export workflow closely, has sensible depth, and the nine screens I opened all support their nodes. It should be filed after small fixes: correct pacing's role (it sets peak spacing in detection, not mainly filtering), add restoring a cycle and checking metric sanity, move the documentation task out of the export phase, and record the edit-mode bugs (plot lag, Overlay tab error).
